calendar_desc: Decides which days count as workdays and which time zone today is read in. Windows and price factors live per provider, on the model × provider association.
load_failed: Failed to load the workday calendar
overrides_empty_hint: No date overrides yet: public holidays and shifted workdays cannot be derived from weekdays, so days without an override fall back to the weekly workday setting.
edit_desc: This one applies to every provider: the time zone windows are evaluated in, which days count as workdays, and the date overrides for public holidays and shifted workdays.
timezone_hint: Time zone used to evaluate windows. Empty means the server's local time zone.
weekdays_hint: Only affects the workday/rest-day condition; public holidays and shifted workdays are handled by the date overrides below.
holiday_hint: Public holidays and shifted workdays cannot be derived from weekdays, so they need external data. A sync replaces the whole selected year and leaves other years alone; on failure the config stays as it was.
terms_section_desc: This provider's own time-of-day pricing: order is priority, and the first window that matches wins. The workday calendar (time zone, holidays) is global — see the Config page.
enabled_hint: When off, this association is billed at the base price; the windows below are kept but unused.
period_time_hint: 24-hour clock, 24:00 allowed; a start later than the end crosses midnight (e.g. 22:00 → 06:00).
multiplier_hint: Multiplier on the base price: 1 is unchanged, 0.25 is 25%.
warn_conflict: Windows {{a}} and {{b}} overlap in time; the earlier one ({{a}}) wins where they overlap.
warn_no_periods: Enabled with no windows: every request will be billed at the base price.

issue.err_same_clock: Window {{index}} ({{name}}): start and end are the same, which would cover the whole day
issue.err_weekday_range: Workday definition has a weekday out of range (0–6, 0=Sunday)
issue.err_override_value: Date override "{{value}}" must be work or rest
issue.err_multiplier: Window {{index}} ({{name}}): price factor "{{value}}" is not a number >= 0

preview_empty: No window matches in this range; everything is billed at the base price.
preview_hint: Replays the windows you have not saved yet over the coming days, to check midnight crossings, weekdays and shifted workdays.
calendar_note: The preview uses the saved workday calendar (time zone and holidays come from the Config page).
